story.summary: Partial editorial analysis started from analysis_bundle_001. The available footage already establishes a journey to Kailasagiri, an unsuccessful breakfast stop, a substantial lunch detour, village/single-lane-road travel, scenic observations, and the planned temple/cave destination with an off-road premise. The final story must be completed only after the remaining bundles are reviewed.
